KIDS SEE GHOSTS was an American hip-hop super-duo composed of musicians Kanye West and Kid Cudi. The duo released their eponymous debut album, Kids See Ghosts, on June 8, 2018, through GOOD Music.

In 2008, then-aspiring artist Kid Cudi caught the attention of rapper-producer Kanye West's A&R at the time, Plain Pat, who had initially met Cudi at a Def Jam meeting and picked up a copy of his demo. Plain Pat went on to introduce Cudi's music to West, subsequently leading West to sign Cudi to his GOOD Music imprint later that year.

title: The Life of Pablo
desc_lfm_album: The Life of Pablo is the seventh studio album by American rapper and producer Kanye West, released in 2016 through GOOD Music and distributed by Def Jam Recordings. The project is widely noted for blending hip-hop with prominent gospel, soul, and experimental elements, and for being presented as a work that continued to evolve after its initial release. The album’s public development traced back to earlier West projects and working concepts during the mid-2010s. In the period leading up to release, West previewed music and ideas under prior working titles, including So Help Me God, before later shifting to SWISH .

Neneh Cherry (born Neneh Marianne Karlsson on March 10, 1964 in Stockholm) is a two-time Grammy Award-nominated and MTV Europe Music Award-winning Swedish singer-songwriter and rapper.
